boundary_evidence: WHOLE UNIT. tu_map calls 0x020ea280..0x020ede18 one contiguous linker run of 61 functions (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses all 61, ROM ordinals 0..60, as one .text claim. Below it, 0x020ea1f0..0x020ea280 is dScMg3DEsp_c_classInit in src/d_s_mg3_d_esp.cpp, a different class; above it is dScMgHanachan_c_classInit in src/minigames/d_s_mg_hanachan.cpp (0x020ede18..0x020edec0), which tu_map does not put in this unit and which stays its own file.

WIDENED from the earlier 49-function claim 0x020eac38..0x020ede18. The hole that bounded it, func_ov006_020ea914 (0x020ea914, size 0x324), has since been byte-matched in its own file (src/func_ov006_020ea914.cpp; its delinks entry was not marked complete). With it the run is one piece. 12 shards were folded: D1, D0 and the ten functions func_ov006_020ea324..func_ov006_020ea914. func_ov006_020ea914 matches here unchanged, with its file-global opt_strength_reduction off now a push/pop bracket.

EDGE 2 IS GONE -- the two contradicting file-global pragmas were dissolved, not worked around. The previous promotion of this class took only ordinals 13..34 (22 functions) because four members reproduce only with `#pragma opt_strength_reduction off` (func_ov006_020eac38, func_ov006_020ec458, func_ov006_020ec93c, func_ov006_020ec9c0) and three only with it on (func_ov006_020ebf20, func_ov006_020ec2bc, func_ov006_020ecba4), while _ZN15dScMgHanachan_c6RenderEv wants `#pragma opt_common_subs off`, which costs five other members when set file-wide. Whole-side scores measured then: SR off / OCS on = 44/49, SR on / OCS on = 42/49, SR off / OCS off = 40/49, and bracketing SR `off ... on` positionally was byte-identical to omitting it. All of that is true only while codegen is DEFERRED. With `#pragma defer_codegen off` at the top of the TU, mwccarm 2004/b56 generates each function at parse time and both pragmas bind POSITIONALLY: the four SR-off members carry their own `#pragma push / opt_strength_reduction off / #pragma pop` bracket, Render carries an opt_common_subs bracket, and all 49 reproduce in one compile. Measured on this TU, not inferred from a sibling.

EDGE 2 addendum -- `defer_codegen off` also flips emission order, and the two effects are one edit. With codegen deferred mwccarm lays .text down in the REVERSE of source order; generating at parse time lays it down in source order. This file is therefore written lowest-ROM-address FIRST, the opposite of the 22-function version. Measured both ways on the identical member set: source ROM-descending + defer_codegen off gives 22/22 MATCH but `21 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order`; source ROM-ascending + defer_codegen off gives 22/22 MATCH and `all 22 in the expected ROM-ascending section order`. Flipping either alone fails the `linkcheck [4b/8]` emission-order refusal. Control on the earlier 49-member file: deleting the `#pragma defer_codegen off` line and changing nothing else costs both properties at once -- 44/49 MATCH (the brackets stop binding and their trailing state goes file-wide, reproducing the earlier pass's 44/49 for strength reduction off) and `48 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order`.

Three byte-diffs that surfaced only in the merge, all fixed at the source and none of them pragma-related. (a) func_ov006_020ec4dc, func_ov006_020ecba4 and func_ov006_020ec9c0 each assign a two-int pair whole-struct; the legacy files were C and block-moved it (ldr/ldr/str/str) where C++ scalarizes (ldr/str/ldr/str), so those three copies go through the array-spelled `struct Words2`. (b) _ZN15dScMgHanachan_c13OnYoshiTryEatEi's read-modify-write of +0xbc let mwcc CSE the field address into its own register (add r2,r4,#0xbc), one word longer than the cartridge's re-issued ldr r1,[r4,#0xbc]; a `const` on the read side defeats the CSE. Seven source forms were tried and six of them match; `x += 1` is the one that does not.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER. The cartridge has D1 at 0x020ea280 below D0 at 0x020ea2c8 and no D2 home. One out-of-line ~dScMgHanachan_c() under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1 then D0 in that order; the D2 mwccarm also emits is a compiler_only_output deadstrip row.

KEY FUNCTION. The out-of-line destructor is the class's first declared virtual, so this TU now emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS15dScMgHanachan_c and the ancestor RTTI chain (fBase_c, dBase_c, dScene_c, dScMgBase_c). Each is a deadstrip-data row with its canonical symbols.txt home; ov006 .data stays ROM-owned, so the TU stays text-only. func_ov006_020ea914's point type Vec2_ea914 also emits a 4-byte vague-linkage D1 with no cartridge copy; it is a deadstrip row.
SOURCE ORDER IS ROM-ASCENDING, lowest address first, under #pragma defer_codegen off; tubuild verify reports all 61 in ROM-ascending emission order.
